title: Agent Handoff Evidence Contract
summary: Transfer work between agents or people with explicit ownership, minimized context, verified state, acceptance evidence, and safe continuation rules.
prerequisites: A workflow boundary with a named source and destination owner

sections.title: Transfer control, not transcript bulk
paragraphs: Name the sending owner, receiving owner, exact outcome, current state, completed actions, unresolved risks, permission boundary, and next bounded action. Pass only the context required for the receiver's role. Treat prior model claims and tool output as untrusted until tied to source or test evidence.

State whether the receiver becomes the user-facing owner or remains a bounded specialist. A handoff description should explain when to route there, but runtime policy must enforce who may access data, invoke tools, approve mutations, and return the final result. Guardrails at one agent boundary do not automatically protect every downstream tool or handoff.

The contract is provider-neutral. Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Phi, NVIDIA, and Z.ai are optional model families or ecosystems that may participate in a deployment, but tools, context limits, permissions, structured-output support, and orchestration interfaces are deployment-specific. Do not infer a capability from a family or vendor label. All correctness checks in this exercise use local bytes and the Python standard library, so they require no model account or paid service.
sections.callout: Role boundary: the producer may make a bounded claim, the consumer independently validates it, and only an authorized human or deployment control may grant approval or mutation authority.

sections.title: Record the handoff package
paragraphs: Reconcile external side effects before transfer. Preserve operation identifiers, idempotency keys, pending approvals, failed attempts, and the system-of-record state so a receiver does not repeat an action after an ambiguous response.

The filled record below is synthetic. It describes local validation only. No external action, approval, signature, network request, remote write, or publication occurred. Labels such as authenticity and human approval are packet claims, not cryptographic or independent evidence.

code.label: worked-handoff-record.txt
code.code:
Handoff ID and time: H-2042-0007, 2026-09-19T00:00:00Z
Task ID and candidate revision: TASK-42-ALPHA, rev-7
Sender / receiver: producer-reviewer -> consumer-validator
Control mode: SPECIALIST RETURNS RESULT
Outcome and done condition: validate artifact.txt for TASK-42-ALPHA; done only when local path, digest, required evidence, scope, revision, side-effect, and expiry checks pass
Authority and permissions:
  ALLOWED: read supplied local files; compute SHA256; report validation; record one intended next step
  MUST ASK: obtain authorized human approval before publication or mutation
  DENIED: network access, external writes, secret access, signature creation, publication, mutation, and approval
Verified current state: local fixture -> candidate rev-7, artifact.txt, side_effect_status NONE_PENDING, as represented at 2026-09-19T00:00:00Z
Completed actions: producer supplied one-byte artifact and packet; consumer is expected to recompute the digest independently
Artifacts and evidence:
  artifact.txt -> supplied byte a
  result-1 -> producer claim PASS_FOR_CONSUMER_VALIDATION
  state-1 -> producer claim rev-7 and NONE_PENDING
Context passed: task ID, candidate revision, owners, artifact reference and digest, exact scope, expiry, evidence, side-effect status, recovery, and intended next step
Context withheld/redacted: prompt transcript and unrelated records -> unnecessary for local validation
Assumptions and unknowns:
  packet authenticity -> UNKNOWN because no trusted signature or independent provenance evidence is supplied
  human approval -> UNKNOWN because no independent approval record is supplied
  external state -> not queried; the exercise validates only the supplied local packet
Rejected/failed attempts: none represented in the baseline fixture
Pending approvals or side effects: publication approval -> human owner; UNKNOWN side-effect state requires stop and reconciliation
Next bounded action: record that consumer-validator would report the local validation result
Verification after next action: confirm the simulator printed an intention only and performed no external instruction
Timeout/escalation: expiry at or before fixed time, UNKNOWN state, or any failed check -> stop and return to producer-reviewer and human-owner
Rollback/recovery: perform no external action; preserve the local packet; report the failed check; reconcile with the system-of-record owner before retrying
Receiver acknowledgement: ACCEPTED only if every consumer check passes

sections.title: Expected evidence and verification
paragraphs: The expected evidence is an acknowledged handoff package that lets the receiver reconstruct the authorized current state, trace material claims, avoid duplicate effects, and know exactly when work is complete or must be escalated.

Test the package with a receiver that has no hidden session history. Confirm evidence references resolve, restricted data is absent, permissions exactly match the required least-privilege set, external state is represented explicitly, and the next action cannot silently exceed scope. Exercise rejection, timeout, cancellation, and return-to-sender paths. Preserve the final acknowledgement and disposition in the applicable system of record.

A verified local digest establishes only that the bytes read by the consumer match the digest recorded in the packet. It does not establish authorship, provenance, safety, human approval, or current external state. This exercise supplies no trusted signature, trusted key, independent approval record, or external-system query. Therefore the rendered authenticity and human-approval results remain UNKNOWN even if packet Boolean fields are true.
sections.callout: Stop criteria: reject malformed or ambiguous data, path escape, task or revision mismatch, unsafe or missing scope, absent or duplicate evidence, changed bytes, expiry at or before the fixed time, and UNKNOWN side-effect state. Recovery requires reporting the failed check and reconciliation by the named owner.

sections.title: Offline producer and consumer exercise
paragraphs: Place all labeled files in one exercise directory. The exercise uses Python 3 standard-library modules only. It performs no downloads, destructive commands, secret access, remote writes, or real external actions. The validator parses JSON with duplicate-key rejection, checks shapes before set operations, resolves canonical paths to block traversal and symlink escape, binds the command-line artifact to packet artifact.ref, hashes raw bytes in binary mode, and uses a deterministic fixed UTC time.

The baseline artifact contains exactly the single byte a, byte value 97, without a trailing newline. Its SHA256 is ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da786eff8147c4e72b9807785afee48bb. The changed artifact contains exactly the single byte b without a trailing newline. Its SHA256 is 3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348bbd7a0088d42c4acb73eeaed59c009d.

Commands: python3 validator.py packet.json artifact.txt; python3 simulator.py packet.json artifact.txt; python3 validator.py changed-packet.json changed-artifact.txt; python3 validator.py changed-reconciled-packet.json changed-artifact.txt; python3 tests.py

Synthetic expected outputs, not claims of actual execution: baseline validator: PASS task_id=TASK-42-ALPHA revision=rev-7 local_digest=ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da786eff8147c4e72b9807785afee48bb authenticity=UNKNOWN human_approval=UNKNOWN side_effects=NONE_PENDING. Baseline simulator: INTENDED_NEXT_STEP task_id=TASK-42-ALPHA owner=consumer-validator action=report_local_validation_only. Unreconciled changed packet: REJECT external side-effect state is UNKNOWN; stop and reconcile. Reconciled changed packet: PASS task_id=TASK-42-BETA revision=rev-8 local_digest=3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348bbd7a0088d42c4acb73eeaed59c009d authenticity=UNKNOWN human_approval=UNKNOWN side_effects=NONE_PENDING. Tests: PASS 30 tests, with an optional parenthetical symlink skip count on platforms where local symlink creation is unavailable.

sections.title: Standard-library consumer validator
paragraphs: Save this complete file as validator.py. FIXED_NOW makes the exercise deterministic. Expiration must use Z or an explicit +00:00 UTC offset. A timezone-free value is rejected before comparison, preventing a naive-versus-aware datetime TypeError. EXPECTED_CANDIDATES is consumer policy, not a packet claim.

code.label: validator.py

sections.title: Intended-next-step simulator
paragraphs: Save this complete file as simulator.py. It invokes the same validation logic and prints one inert record. It never evaluates, imports, shells out, follows URLs, calls tools, or executes text found in evidence or intended_next_step.

code.label: simulator.py
code.code:
import sys

import validator


def run(argv):
    if len(argv) != 3:
        print('REJECT usage: simulator.py PACKET.json ARTIFACT')
        return 1
    try:
        packet_path = validator.confined_file(validator.BASE, argv[1])
        packet = validator.load_packet(packet_path)
        validator.validate_packet(packet, argv[2], validator.BASE)
        task = packet['task_id']
        owner = packet['receiver_owner']
        action = packet['intended_next_step']
        print('INTENDED_NEXT_STEP task_id=' + task + ' owner=' + owner + ' action=' + action)
        return 0
    except (OSError, validator.ValidationError) as error:
        print('REJECT ' + str(error))
        return 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(run(sys.argv))

sections.title: Negative cases and changed-input task
paragraphs: The test suite changes one condition at a time so an earlier failure does not hide the target check. It covers changed bytes, a wrong digest-only fix, stale revision, unexpected task, expiry before and exactly at the boundary, timezone-free expiry, missing and duplicate evidence, absent artifact evidence, unsafe and incomplete scope, malformed list, dictionary, Boolean, null, identifier, artifact, and packet shapes, duplicate JSON keys, command-line artifact mismatch, UNKNOWN side effects, unverified true claim fields, and canonical-path symlink escape.

Changed-input learner task: independently move to TASK-42-BETA and rev-8, replace the artifact byte a with b, update the artifact reference and digest, and represent the post-producer side-effect state as UNKNOWN. Run the unchanged validator. Explain why digest validation cannot authorize continuation while side effects are unreconciled. Then inspect the separate reconciled fixture and identify who owns recovery, why approval remains UNKNOWN, and why the simulator may record only an intended next step.

Actionable feedback: do not alter the expected task or revision merely to bypass a mismatch. Return stale or UNKNOWN packets to producer-reviewer and human-owner. Reconcile the real system of record through an authorized process, create a new bounded packet, recompute the digest over final bytes, and obtain approval independently if publication is required. The local consumer cannot perform or claim those actions.

sections.title: Complete changed-input solution
paragraphs: This complete changed packet is the answer before reconciliation. TASK-42-BETA and rev-8 are independently recognized by unchanged consumer policy, and the b-byte digest is correct. Validation nevertheless stops on UNKNOWN side effects. Expected output: REJECT external side-effect state is UNKNOWN; stop and reconcile. This separates the side-effect failure from stale-revision and digest failures.

sections.title: Complete offline test suite
paragraphs: Save this complete file as tests.py. It creates only temporary files under the exercise directory. The symlink test creates a harmless sentinel beside an isolated temporary root and skips only when local symlink creation is unavailable. It never targets a real sensitive path. The custom runner emits a deterministic functional summary rather than claiming these tests were run while drafting.

code.label: tests.py
code.code:
import contextlib
import copy
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest

import simulator
import validator

A_HASH = 'ca978112ca1bbdcafac231b39a23dc4da786eff8147c4e72b9807785afee48bb'
B_HASH = '3e23e8160039594a33894f6564e1b1348bbd7a0088d42c4acb73eeaed59c009d'


def baseline():
    return {
        'task_id': 'TASK-42-ALPHA',
        'candidate_revision': 'rev-7',
        'sender_owner': 'producer-reviewer',
        'receiver_owner': 'consumer-validator',
        'artifact': {'ref': 'artifact.txt', 'sha256': A_HASH},
        'scope': ['read_local_artifact', 'compute_sha256', 'report_validation'],
        'expires_at': '2026-09-20T00:00:00Z',
        'side_effect_status': 'NONE_PENDING',
        'authenticity': False,
        'human_approved': False,
        'evidence': [
            {'ref': 'artifact.txt', 'kind': 'artifact', 'result': 'bytes supplied locally'},
            {'ref': 'result-1', 'kind': 'producer_result', 'result': 'PASS_FOR_CONSUMER_VALIDATION'},
            {'ref': 'state-1', 'kind': 'system_of_record_claim', 'result': 'rev-7 and NONE_PENDING'},
        ],
        'recovery': 'Stop and reconcile with the owner.',
        'intended_next_step': 'report_local_validation_only',
    }


class ContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='handoff-test-', dir=validator.BASE)
        self.write_bytes('artifact.txt', b'a')

    def tearDown(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.root, ignore_errors=True)

    def write_bytes(self, name, data):
        path = os.path.join(self.root, name)
        with open(path, 'wb') as handle:
            handle.write(data)

    def check(self, packet, artifact='artifact.txt'):
        return validator.validate_packet(packet, artifact, self.root)

    def rejected(self, packet, message, artifact='artifact.txt'):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(validator.ValidationError, message):
            self.check(packet, artifact)

    def test_01_baseline_passes(self):
        output = self.check(baseline())
        self.assertIn('local_digest=' + A_HASH, output)

    def test_02_changed_artifact_rejected(self):
        self.write_bytes('artifact.txt', b'b')
        self.rejected(baseline(), 'changed artifact')

    def test_03_wrong_digest_only_fix_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['artifact']['sha256'] = B_HASH
        self.rejected(packet, 'changed artifact')

    def test_04_stale_revision_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['candidate_revision'] = 'rev-6'
        self.rejected(packet, 'stale or unexpected')

    def test_05_unexpected_task_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['task_id'] = 'TASK-42-GAMMA'
        self.rejected(packet, 'unexpected task_id')

    def test_06_expired_before_boundary(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['expires_at'] = '2026-09-18T00:00:00Z'
        self.rejected(packet, 'evidence expired')

    def test_07_expired_at_boundary(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['expires_at'] = validator.FIXED_NOW
        self.rejected(packet, 'evidence expired')

    def test_08_naive_expiry_rejected_cleanly(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['expires_at'] = '2026-09-20T00:00:00'
        self.rejected(packet, 'explicit UTC offset')

    def test_09_missing_result_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['evidence'] = [x for x in packet['evidence'] if x['ref'] != 'result-1']
        self.rejected(packet, 'required result evidence')

    def test_10_duplicate_ref_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['evidence'].append({'ref': 'state-1', 'kind': 'copy', 'result': 'copy'})
        self.rejected(packet, 'duplicate evidence')

    def test_11_missing_artifact_evidence_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['evidence'] = [x for x in packet['evidence'] if x['ref'] != 'artifact.txt']
        self.rejected(packet, 'artifact evidence is absent')

    def test_12_scope_escalation_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['scope'].append('publish_external')
        self.rejected(packet, 'unsafe scope escalation')

    def test_13_missing_scope_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['scope'].remove('report_validation')
        self.rejected(packet, 'required scope is missing')

    def test_14_unknown_side_effects_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['side_effect_status'] = 'UNKNOWN'
        self.rejected(packet, 'UNKNOWN; stop and reconcile')

    def test_15_packet_list_shape_rejected(self):
        self.rejected([], 'packet must be an object')

    def test_16_scope_dict_shape_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['scope'] = {'read_local_artifact': True}
        self.rejected(packet, 'scope must be a list')

    def test_17_scope_boolean_item_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['scope'][0] = True
        self.rejected(packet, 'scope must be a list of strings')

    def test_18_scope_null_item_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['scope'][0] = None
        self.rejected(packet, 'scope must be a list of strings')

    def test_19_evidence_string_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['evidence'] = ['not-an-object']
        self.rejected(packet, 'evidence must be a list of objects')

    def test_20_null_evidence_ref_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['evidence'][0]['ref'] = None
        self.rejected(packet, 'evidence ref')

    def test_21_invalid_boolean_and_null_claims_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['authenticity'] = 'false'
        self.rejected(packet, 'authenticity must be Boolean')
        packet = baseline()
        packet['human_approved'] = None
        self.rejected(packet, 'human_approved must be Boolean')

    def test_22_artifact_null_shape_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['artifact'] = None
        self.rejected(packet, 'artifact must be an object')

    def test_23_invalid_id_shapes_rejected(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['task_id'] = '../TASK'
        self.rejected(packet, 'task_id has invalid shape')
        packet = baseline()
        packet['candidate_revision'] = []
        self.rejected(packet, 'candidate_revision must be a nonempty string')

    def test_24_artifact_argument_binding(self):
        self.write_bytes('other.txt', b'a')
        self.rejected(baseline(), 'artifact argument does not match', 'other.txt')

    def test_25_duplicate_json_key_rejected(self):
        path = os.path.join(self.root, 'duplicate.json')
        with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            handle.write('{"task_id":"TASK-42-ALPHA","task_id":"TASK-42-BETA"}')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(validator.ValidationError, 'duplicate JSON key'):
            validator.load_packet(path)

    def test_26_symlink_escape_rejected(self):
        outside = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=validator.BASE, delete=False)
        outside.write(b'a')
        outside.close()
        link = os.path.join(self.root, 'link.txt')
        try:
            try:
                os.symlink(outside.name, link)
            except (OSError, NotImplementedError) as error:
                self.skipTest('local symlink unavailable: ' + str(error))
            packet = baseline()
            packet['artifact']['ref'] = 'link.txt'
            packet['evidence'][0]['ref'] = 'link.txt'
            self.rejected(packet, 'file path escapes exercise directory', 'link.txt')
        finally:
            if os.path.lexists(link):
                os.unlink(link)
            os.unlink(outside.name)

    def test_27_changed_task_unknown_is_independent(self):
        self.write_bytes('changed-artifact.txt', b'b')
        packet = baseline()
        packet['task_id'] = 'TASK-42-BETA'
        packet['candidate_revision'] = 'rev-8'
        packet['artifact'] = {'ref': 'changed-artifact.txt', 'sha256': B_HASH}
        packet['evidence'][0]['ref'] = 'changed-artifact.txt'
        packet['side_effect_status'] = 'UNKNOWN'
        self.rejected(packet, 'UNKNOWN; stop and reconcile', 'changed-artifact.txt')

    def test_28_changed_task_reconciled_passes(self):
        self.write_bytes('changed-artifact.txt', b'b')
        packet = baseline()
        packet['task_id'] = 'TASK-42-BETA'
        packet['candidate_revision'] = 'rev-8'
        packet['artifact'] = {'ref': 'changed-artifact.txt', 'sha256': B_HASH}
        packet['evidence'][0]['ref'] = 'changed-artifact.txt'
        packet['evidence'][2]['result'] = 'rev-8 and NONE_PENDING'
        output = self.check(packet, 'changed-artifact.txt')
        self.assertIn('local_digest=' + B_HASH, output)

    def test_29_true_claims_remain_unknown(self):
        packet = baseline()
        packet['authenticity'] = True
        packet['human_approved'] = True
        output = self.check(packet)
        self.assertIn('authenticity=UNKNOWN human_approval=UNKNOWN', output)

    def test_30_simulator_records_only_intention(self):
        packet_path = os.path.join(self.root, 'packet.json')
        with open(packet_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            json.dump(baseline(), handle)
        old_base = validator.BASE
        validator.BASE = self.root
        stream = io.StringIO()
        try:
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stream):
                result = simulator.run(['simulator.py', 'packet.json', 'artifact.txt'])
        finally:
            validator.BASE = old_base
        self.assertEqual(result, 0)
        self.assertEqual(stream.getvalue().strip(), 'INTENDED_NEXT_STEP task_id=TASK-42-ALPHA owner=consumer-validator action=report_local_validation_only')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(ContractTests)
    stream = io.StringIO()
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=0).run(suite)
    if result.wasSuccessful():
        suffix = '' if len(result.skipped) == 0 else ' (symlink skips=' + str(len(result.skipped)) + ')'
        print('PASS ' + str(suite.countTestCases()) + ' tests' + suffix)
    else:
        print(stream.getvalue(), end='')
        raise SystemExit(1)

sections.title: Reusable handoff evidence template
paragraphs: Fill every field. Use UNKNOWN when a fact is not established, and name the test or owner that would establish it. The receiver must not depend on hidden transcript history. The next action must be one bounded action. Expiration, scope mismatch, unresolved effects, and failed evidence checks are stop conditions, not suggestions.

code.label: handoff-template.txt
code.code:
Handoff ID and time: [ID, ISO UTC TIMESTAMP]
Task ID and candidate revision: [TASK ID, REVISION]
Sender owner / receiver owner: [ROLE -> ROLE]
Control mode: [TRANSFER OWNERSHIP | SPECIALIST RETURNS RESULT]
Outcome and done condition: [RESULT, ACCEPTANCE TEST]
Authority and permissions:
  ALLOWED: [EXACT LEAST-PRIVILEGE OPERATIONS]
  MUST ASK: [APPROVALS AND OWNER]
  DENIED: [OPERATIONS]
Verified current state: [SYSTEM OF RECORD -> STATE, AS OF]
Completed actions: [ACTION, OPERATION OR IDEMPOTENCY ID, POSTCONDITION]
Artifacts and evidence: [REF -> CLAIM; LOCALLY VERIFIED DIGEST IF APPLICABLE]
Context passed: [MINIMUM DATA]
Context withheld/redacted: [DATA -> REASON]
Assumptions and unknowns: [ITEM -> VALIDATION TEST OR OWNER]
Rejected/failed attempts: [ATTEMPT -> RESULT]
Pending approvals or side effects: [ITEM -> OWNER; UNKNOWN REQUIRES STOP]
Next bounded action: [ONE INERT OR AUTHORIZED ACTION]
Verification after next action: [INDEPENDENT CHECK]
Timeout/escalation: [EXPIRY OR FAILURE -> OWNER]
Rollback/recovery: [STOP; PRESERVE EVIDENCE; RECONCILE EXTERNAL STATE; RETRY CONDITIONS]
Authenticity evidence: [TRUSTED INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE | UNKNOWN]
Human approval evidence: [INDEPENDENT APPROVAL RECORD | UNKNOWN]
Receiver acknowledgement: [ACCEPTED | REJECTED WITH REASON]

sections.title: Sources and limitations
paragraphs: Python hashlib.sha256 computes a SHA256 digest from bytes. A SHA256 digest is 256 bits, which renders as 64 hexadecimal digits because each hexadecimal digit represents four bits. This exercise reads artifact files in binary mode and hashes their raw bytes. Python datetime.fromisoformat parses supported ISO 8601 forms, but this validator additionally requires explicit UTC and rejects timezone-free input before comparison.

Python json.load parses JSON data, while object_pairs_hook permits this exercise to detect duplicate object keys. Canonical path checks use realpath and commonpath so lexical traversal and supported symlink escapes are rejected. These controls are an educational local boundary, not a full operating-system sandbox.

The lesson does not establish packet authenticity, approval, current external-system state, artifact safety, or vendor behavior. Establishing those facts would require deployment-specific trusted provenance, authorization, system-of-record access, policy enforcement, and responsible owners. None is supplied here.
